title: ST Headcover
body_html: In the mountains of Guarda, the Manta Lobeira is still woven from churra wool on a 300-year-old manual loom. For this collaboration with Ra-Ro and Slice Town, we designed a headcover that carries forward the weight, tactility, and memory of the original material into a different setting.

title: Grape Course Case
body_html: Our Course Cases are handmade with rescued high-quality wool fabrics woven at factories in the mountain region of Serra da Estrela. The inside is equipped with a pocket to hold ball markers and with loops to keep a few tees close. The rest is left open for a rangefinder, valuables, or whatever finds its way into the bag. The case comes with a metal caribiner.
